questions.question: How many men did God leave Gideon to fight Midian?
How did Gideon's men attack the Midianite camp?
options: With arrows, from the surrounding hills
With trumpets, torches, and jars, shouting
With swords, fighting hand to hand
On horseback, charging through the camp
questions.answer: With trumpets, torches, and jars, shouting

questions.question: God reduced Gideon's army so Israel could not boast that their own strength saved them.
